goal: Implement EquipmentCatalog with register, get_equipment, claim, release and uniform dict returns
checks: register('CAM-1') returns {ok:true,data:{equipment_id:'CAM-1',status:'AVAILABLE'}}; second register returns DUPLICATE; 'cam-1' succeeds independently
get_equipment('CAM-1') returns AVAILABLE snapshot; get_equipment('UNKNOWN') returns NOT_FOUND
claim('CAM-1') returns UNAVAILABLE; claim on UNAVAILABLE returns error; claim('UNKNOWN') returns NOT_FOUND
release('CAM-1') returns AVAILABLE; release on AVAILABLE returns INVALID_TRANSITION; release('UNKNOWN') returns NOT_FOUND
State snapshots before and after any failed claim or release remain identical
Methods with '' or 123 as equipment_id return {ok:false,error:{code:'INVALID_ARGUMENT'}}
Two independent EquipmentCatalog instances do not share data

goal: Implement LoanService with injected catalog and one history snapshot per loan in reservation order, reflecting the current status.
checks: reserve('L1','CAM-1') returns RESERVED; repeated reserve returns same; reserve('L1','CAM-2') returns CONFLICT
reserve('L2','UNKNOWN') returns NOT_FOUND; reserve on UNAVAILABLE returns error; failed reserve adds no record
checkout('L1') returns CHECKED_OUT; catalog shows UNAVAILABLE after checkout
return_equipment('L1') returns RETURNED; catalog shows AVAILABLE after return
cancel('L1') returns CANCELLED; catalog shows AVAILABLE after cancel
checkout on RETURNED returns INVALID_TRANSITION; ops on 'UNKNOWN' loan_id return NOT_FOUND
Reserve L1, then checkout and return L1 before reserving L2 on CAM-1; history is [L1 RETURNED, L2 RESERVED]. CAM-2 is empty; unknown ID NOT_FOUND.
Mutating returned history list does not change next call; CAM-2 records absent from CAM-1 history
For each bad ID '' and 123 call reserve(bad,'CAM-1') and reserve('L1',bad) directly; both return INVALID_ARGUMENT and keep catalog/history unchanged.
Call checkout(bad), return_equipment(bad), cancel(bad), and history(bad) directly with '' and 123. Expect INVALID_ARGUMENT without changing state.
Use two separate catalogs and loan services; a loan reserved in the first service is absent from the second service's history.

summarize([]) returns {ok:true,data:{total:0,reserved:0,checked_out:0,returned:0,cancelled:0}}
Input list identity and contents unchanged after summarize call
summarize accepts plain list of dicts matching history shape without LoanService dependency
Methods with invalid argument types return {ok:false,error:{code:'INVALID_ARGUMENT'}}
